description: Check an email subject line. Pass `subject`. Reports length in characters (phones show roughly the first 30 to 45; desktop 55 to 70, estimates), word count, spam-trigger words from a short list of about 35 phrases (filters weigh many signals, so a hit is a nudge, not a verdict), ALL CAPS, repeated punctuation, dollar signs and percent claims, emoji count, fake Re:/Fwd:, leading or trailing spaces, and personalisation placeholders (found, missing fallback, unbalanced braces, empty tags, leftover undefined/null/NaN).
name: check_email_subject
title: Email subject line check
